  Draft resolution submitted by the President of the General Assembly  
 
 
  United Nations Declaration on Sea Level Rise  
 
 
 The General Assembly , 
 Adopts  the declaration entitled “United Nations Declaration on Sea Level Rise”, 
pursuant to the high -level meeting on addressing the existential threats posed by sea 
level rise, held on 24 September 2026 in accordance with General Assembly decision 
78/558 of 1 A ugust 2024, as contained in the annex to the present resolution.  
 
  Annex 
 
  United Nations Declaration on Sea Level Rise  
 
 1. We, the Heads of State and Government and high -level representatives to 
the opening of the eighty -first session of the General Assembly, at the high -level 
meeting to enhance action on sea level rise, proclaim this United Nations declaration 
on sea level ri se. 
 2. We are deeply concerned about sea level rise. Sea level rise is not a distant 
scenario, but a real and lived experience for many. Rising sea levels are primarily 
driven by ocean warming and melting ice sheets and glaciers, and we note with 
concern this phe nomenon is accelerating. It imperils people living on islands and in 
coastal regions, low -lying deltas and archipelagos around the world, and erodes hard -
won development gains, especially for developing countries and, in particular, small 
island developing  States and least developed countries. Its cumulative, severe and 
irreversible risks demand stronger international cooperation and urgent, coordinated 
action. Adaptation and mitigation action, based on the best available science and 
knowledge, is essential  to addressing sea level rise.  
 3. We affirm the need to implement international law in our response to sea 
level rise, including the law of the sea as reflected in the United Nations Convention 
on the Law of the Sea. 1

 1  United Nations, Treaty Series , vol. 1833, No. 31363.
